build_discrete_filtered_q_network: build a DiscreteFilteredQNetwork with a g_network, q_network, and threshold for discrete BCQ
create_g_network_module: create a sonnet Module to use as the g_network for action filtering in DiscreteFilteredQNetwork
create_q_network_module: create a sonnet Module to use as the q_network for Q-value estimation in DiscreteFilteredQNetwork
run_filtered_q_forward_pass: run a forward pass through DiscreteFilteredQNetwork with an observation tensor to get filtered Q values
review_threshold_filtering_logic: review the DiscreteFilteredQNetwork threshold filtering logic that replaces low-confidence Q values with the minimum Q
